correctness.rationale: Zuo's norm-comparison inequality gives \(C_P(X)\le d_{\mathrm{BM}}(X,\ell_2^2)^2\), and Zuo's Example 2.10 gives \(C_P(X)=1+1/\sqrt5\). For \(|(x,y)|_*^2=5x^2+y^2\), the squared quotient is \((5+2t+t^2)/(4(5+t^2))\) with \(t=|y|/|x|\). Its derivative has the sign of \(5-t^2\), so its minimum is \(1/4\) at the axis limits and its maximum is \((5+\sqrt5)/20\) at \(t=\sqrt5\). This gives \(d_{\mathrm{BM}}^2\le1+1/\sqrt5\), hence equality.
